title: Export formula-injection and accessible workflow supplement
safety_limits: synthetic cells and generated local artifacts only; no real customer or transaction data
no GitHub mutation, product execution, runtime connection, SQL execution, deployment, or production operation
opening a generated spreadsheet in an unisolated desktop application is outside this preparation

eligibility.required_runtime: isolated export generator and disposable spreadsheet-analysis sandbox

cases.attack_or_failure: export synthetic values beginning with =, +, -, @, tab, carriage return, and Unicode lookalikes
cases.expected_result: every untrusted value remains literal in every supported export format
cases.evidence_to_pass: file-level parse proves no formula, external link, macro, or DDE-capable cell

cases.attack_or_failure: inject CR/LF, path separators, bidi controls, reserved names, and extension confusion into saved-view/report labels
cases.expected_result: server emits a safe deterministic filename and one unambiguous media type
cases.evidence_to_pass: header parser, filesystem-name corpus, and download UX assertion

cases.attack_or_failure: combine hidden columns, active filters, unloaded rows, and a revoked export capability after job enqueue
cases.expected_result: worker reauthorizes immutable scope and excludes hidden/foreign fields rather than exporting the visible cache
cases.evidence_to_pass: queued-job revocation test plus parsed column/row manifest

cases.attack_or_failure: progress, completion, failure, and cancellation are conveyed only by color, animation, or an unlabeled toast
cases.expected_result: named live status is non-spammy, focus remains stable, and the final artifact action is keyboard reachable
cases.evidence_to_pass: screen-reader transcript, focus trace, and duplicate-announcement assertion

cases.attack_or_failure: round-trip synthetic leading zeros, long identifiers, dates, decimal separators, and RTL text under two locales
cases.expected_result: declared schema preserves identity and value semantics without spreadsheet auto-coercion
cases.evidence_to_pass: schema-aware round-trip comparison across both locales

cases.entry_point: cancel and retry after ambiguous download
cases.attack_or_failure: disconnect after generation completes but before acknowledgement, then retry with the same request identity
cases.expected_result: UI reconciles artifact state, does not silently duplicate generation, and never labels unknown completion as failure or success
cases.evidence_to_pass: disconnect/reconcile trace with one authoritative artifact identity and explicit OutcomeUnknown transition
